topic: Youth-led Cockroach Janata Party (Gen-Z) protests against the BJP government purge of voter rolls, New Delhi and other cities, 150+ arrests, UN experts demand probe
scale: Thousands demonstrated in central New Delhi (WSWS); UN experts cite repeated heavy-handed police response to peaceful youth-led demonstrations in New Delhi and other Indian cities over the past three months (India Today)
quote1: UN human rights experts urged India to end alleged excessive force against peaceful youth-led protests.
quote2: Despite massive state repression, India’s Narendra Modi-led, far-right BJP government has failed to stamp out a wave of youth-led protests against its purge of millions of rural poor and working-class voters from the electoral rolls.
